chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Neemiias gu mar gu akâliias; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kisleu oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook kua' tu' gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Na suudai' u'va gu anani maa'n gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu ñi'ook gu Judiios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x oidha' gɨ' cham bhai' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem kiki'ñgob gu tai.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhɨt gu tanoolh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr jix kavɨk jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook jix nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu vupui na ba' soi'm tu duukam tu' jano' vupui bhaan tu' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu duukam; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vaak gu taat uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Moisees tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tu duukam bham; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ u'u kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' pai' na ba' bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak soi'm tu duukam soi'm tu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu duukam jix duñia' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; na gu' tu' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nisaan oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes kua' tu' suudai' u'va vupui bhaan suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ja'p tu' cham ka't dhi' va'k jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'ook cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tai na ba' bɨɨx tas; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vupui na pai' dhuuk kiicham gu vaak pai'm tattat oidha' jix gaki kiki'ñgob gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Judaa kiicham pai'm tattat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ju'ñdharan; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't gu ñi'ook duuk jix maat gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr tu' nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Asap jix nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu u'u na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' vaak jodai kiicham gu vaak pai' ba'k; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sanballat gu oronita gu Tobiias tu duukam gu Ammonita oi'ñdha' na ba' xoi'kam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem dhi' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' tu' gu chio'ñ cham gu chio'ñ oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' ka't gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' ki'ñgob gu Balle bhaan suudai' buusñi gu Dragoon ki'ñgob gu Muladar; gio ba' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem mi'p kiki'ñgob mi'p gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu Puente gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gu' cham ka't pai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'ñbak gu tukaa' vaak jodai ki'ñgob gu Balle.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'rosiiris duukat tu' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' ka't tu' jix duñia' gu Judiios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu' gu bhóogɨt o'rosiiris tu' duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham bhai' dhi' gu Jerusalem oidha' jix gaki kiki'ñgob gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu Jerusalem cham tu'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu Lebanteemonos; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' xoi'kam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu Samballat gu oronita gu Tobiias tu duukam gu Ammonita gu Gesem gu Arabe gu ñi'ook no'ch jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' xoi'kam bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr no'ch tu duukam; na gu ñi'ook cham namki' baasɨ'n tu' gu ñi'ook tu' chɨ'ñchoka' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Eliasib jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu Obejas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup kiki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Mea bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu ananeel.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jerikoo; gio ba' pai'x gu Sakûr gu mar gu Imri.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Senaa gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu Peskado; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup kiki'ñgob bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Meremot gu mar gu Uriias gu mar gu Kos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Mesullam gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Mesesabeel; mi' dhɨr ju'ñdharan gu Sadok gu mar gu Baana.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tekoitas; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Bieja gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joiada gu mar gu Pasea gu Mesullam gu mar gu Besodiias; gio ba' jix búup kiki'ñgob bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Melatiias gu Gabaonita gu Jadoon gu Meronotita gu chio'ñ gu Gabaoon gu Mispa gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussiel gu mar gu araiia; gio ba' ju'ñdharan gio gu ananiias gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Repaiias gu mar gu ur gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jedaiias gu mar gu arumap; gio ba' ju'ñdharan gu attus gu mar gu asbaniias.
Jano' ba' gu Malkîas gu mar gu arim gu asub gu mar gu Paat-moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu ornos.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sallum gu mar gu Loes gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Balle gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu anuun bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Sanoa; gio ba' jix búup kiki'ñgob bɨɨx jix bhai'x vaak jodai bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu Muladar.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu Muladar gu Malkîas gu mar gu Rekâb gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' gu Bet-akkerem; gio ba' jix búup kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' gu Sallum gu mar gu Kôl-oke gu ñi'ook gu Mispa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu Puente; gio ba' jix búup kiki'ñgob vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu Sela bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Neemiias gu mar gu Asbuk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Bet-sur bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan pai'm gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu Reum gu mar gu Bani; gio ba' ju'ñdharan gu Asabiias gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Keila gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Babbai gu mar gu enadad gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Keila.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eser gu mar gu Jesuaa gu ñi'ook gu Mispa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baruk gu mar gu Sakâi gu ñi'ook dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Eliasib jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Meremot gu mar gu Uriias gu mar gu Kos gu ñi'ook dɨr ba'k gu vaak gu Eliasib bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Eliasib.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu chio'ñ vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin gu asub gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu Asariias gu mar gu Maasiias gu mar gu Ananiias mia'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Binnui gu mar gu enadad gu ñi'ook dɨr gu vaak gu Asariias bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Paal gu mar gu Usai gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' naadat kuupa'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Pedaiia gu mar gu Paros.
Jano' ba' gu Netineos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Opel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu suudai' tas buusñi bhi'ñbak daam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tekoitas gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' bhi'ñbak daam bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai gu Opel.
Jano' ba' dɨr ki'ñgob gu Kaballos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sadok gu mar gu Immer gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Semaiias gu mar gu Sekâniias jix nukadham ki'ñgob gu ux na tu ibai'.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ananiias gu mar gu Selemiias gu Anuun gu mar xijumai gu Salap gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Mesullam gu mar gu Berekîas gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Malkîas gu mar gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Netineos gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu Obejas.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na ja'p jix kai gu Sanballat no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bhaam tu' gu Judiios.

Ba' jix aa' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Samaria; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam dhi' ja'tkam gu Judiios jix duñia' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix duñia' gɨ' kavɨk oo' gu jodai jix bɨɨx duu.
Ba' jix aa' ka't ju'ñdharan gu Tobiias gu Ammonita; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'x vaak jodai gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu'ch bhaan mo'o jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' uañi'ñ ka't vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bɨx vaak jodai ka't bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨiñ gu Sanballat gu Tobiias gu Arabes gu Ammonitas gu Asdod vaak jodai gu Jerusalem jix duñia' na gu' tu' kua'da' jix duu jix jai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx na ba' gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha jix nukadham bhaan gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' na jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix jai' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; gio ba' cham tu' bɨɨx ka'm kapbhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p tɨɨtɨs gu Judiios oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maa aa'ñdham mambhɨɨx mui'kim bɨx gu ñi'ook pai' no'ch.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' vaak jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx u'uux bɨɨx u'u kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook o'rosiiris gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu u'vɨ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p dua'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨx vaak jodai maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' ka't dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ biipibop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ ga'ra' u'u kavɨk kutun kavɨk u'u gat; gio ba' chiñia' mi'p bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bɨɨx gu novɨ tu duukam ko'kmarak gu kuchii.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ga'ra' gu kuchii; gio ba' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk ka't ju'ñdharan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook o'rosiiris gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu duukam jix gɨ' no'ch dhi' vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk no'ch; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ko'kmarak u'u kavɨk dɨr gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu si'avag.
Jano' ba' gio tu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' maa'n bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' gu tanoolh tu duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' tɨi'chu'; gio ba' maa'n na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu u'vɨ bhaan gu Judiios gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't chɨtda; gio ba' no'ch maraa'n gu ma'nkam maraa'n ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu'ch mui'x; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kai'ñ na ba' jugi duaka'.
Jano' ba' ka't am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam oi'ñga'n vaas oidha' u'va oi'ñga'n vaas gu vaak na ba' kai'ñ bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' ka't am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ na ba' namki'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan oi'ñga'n vaas oidha' u'va.

Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug na ja'p gu chuukug xibhɨk gu ja'tkam xibhɨk gu ma'nkam na ja'p gu ma'nkam; gio ba' no'ch xibhɨk gu ma'nkam xibhɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ juantu'n cham tu'x jai'ch xibhɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; na gu' gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch xibhɨk gu noobh na ba' na gu' xibhɨk oidha' u'va.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook o'rosiiris; gio ba' maa'n gu ja'tkam bhaan jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' no'ch xibhɨk gu ja'tkam gu Judiios jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp jurtu'nka' ka't no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't no'ch cham chooto'n tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham xoi'kam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham chɨbɨɨp obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gio tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuumiñ kai'ñ; gio ba' jano' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu vaak baasɨ'n tuumiñ kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñchuda' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jurtu'nka' dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak tu jiim bɨx gu chio'ñ cham dhi' ka't cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr jix aa' bɨx; jano' ba' gu Ameen gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duu jurtu'nka' dhi'.

Jano' ba' gio dɨr gu tanoolh jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' jum duu gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu oidha' gu Judaa dɨr oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.

Gu' gu' dharka' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' suudai' u'va bhaan oo'm jix toja jodai; gio ba' dhi' bhaan gu ja'tkam; gu' tu' cham kuiñcha choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook dhi' vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n cham gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bɨx tɨtda:―Aañ mi'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judiios o'rosiiris aajidha' no'ch chɨbɨɨp mi'p gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu vaakax kakneer gu u'uvhig gio na ba' tu' mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh suudai' u'va bɨx; na gu' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' cham pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' na gu' juantu'n dhi' gu ja'tkam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' ka't dhaibu naak gu Sanballat gu Tobiias gu Gesem gu Arabe gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ ka't tu' vaak jodai cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Sanballat gu Gesem mɨjɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨtda:―Aañ taañpu' yooxi' gu Ono; gu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' tu' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook cham tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh mui'kim tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhañ jano' ba' gu Sanballat tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' ka't ua'nak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu Gasmu tu ñi'ook tu' gu Judiios ba'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' vaak jodai bɨɨx bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jerusalem bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jano' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Aañ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' a'ga; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu noobh gu ñi'ook cham ka't; mi' dhɨr gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨxchuixim gu vaak gu Semaiias gu mar gu Delaiias gu mar gu Meetabeel na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan na gu' jupaabkamu'n na ba' kooda'; jano' ba' dhi' gu tukaa' aajim kooda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka na ja'p tu' mai' ba'k vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba' gu oidha' cham ba'k.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu ñi'ook ua'rgidhimɨk mii' dhɨr ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan bhaan tu' na gu' gu Tobiias gu Sanballat a'ga.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx mai' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Tobiias gu Sanballat jurtu'nka' dhi' buimɨi gio gu Noadiias gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ɨɨbhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elul mambhɨɨx gook gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx chɨbɨɨp mi'p obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh jix jai' gu vupui jix maati' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix duñia' mumua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Tobiias aajidha'.
Na gu' na gu' mui'x gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na gu' ka't gu Sekâniias gu mar gu Ara; gio ba' gu Joanaan gu mar ka't jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu Mesullam gu mar gu Berekîas.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' jix bhai' buimɨi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Tobiias gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' vaak jodai ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob jix bɨɨx duu miil gu Lebitas.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu anani gu ananiias gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem na gu' ka't na ja'p gu chio'ñ tu'r jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios bhaan mui'x; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm jix tónom gu tas; mi' dhɨr kiki'ñgob; jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat nuuka'n gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook maa'n vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' kiicham ka't gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook o'rosiiris gu ja'tkam na ba' bhaai'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook u'uan jix duñia' va'k ua'nak.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam oidha' gɨ' jix tɨ'ɨ gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia suulh gu Jerusalem gu Judaa maa'n kiicham.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu Sorobabeel gu Jesuaa gu Neemiias gu Asariias gu Raamiias gu Naamani gu Mardokêo gu Bilsaan gu Misperet gu Bigbai gu Neum gu Baana; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paros gook jix bhai'x chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paat-moab gu ma'nkam gu Jesuaa gu Joab gook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sattu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sakâi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Binnui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bebai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asgad gook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adonikam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bigbai gook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Addin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ater gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu asum vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Besai vaik maakob.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arip chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gabaoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-leem gu Netopa chamaam jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Anatot chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-asmabet oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Kîriat-jearim gu Kepira gu Beerot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm vaik.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Rama gu Gebaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Mikmas chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-el gu Ai chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Nebo mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jerikoo vaik oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lod gu adid gu Ono gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Senaa vaik jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedaiias gu vaak gu Jesuaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Immer jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pasur jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jesuaa gu Kadmiel gu ma'nkam gu Odebiia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap chamaam oo'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sallum gu ma'nkam gu Ater gu ma'nkam gu Talmoon gu ma'nkam gu Akkub gu ma'nkam gu atita gu ma'nkam gu Sobai chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sia gu ma'nkam gu asupa gu ma'nkam gu Tabaot.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kêros gu ma'nkam gu Siaa gu ma'nkam gu Padoon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebana gu ma'nkam gu agaba gu ma'nkam gu Salmai.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu anaan gu ma'nkam gu Giddel gu ma'nkam gu Gaar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reaiia gu ma'nkam gu Resiin gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gassam gu ma'nkam gu Ussa gu ma'nkam gu Pasea.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Besai gu ma'nkam gu Meunim gu ma'nkam gu Nepisesim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bakbuk gu ma'nkam gu akupa gu ma'nkam gu arur.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Baslit gu ma'nkam gu Meida gu ma'nkam gu arsa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Barkos gu ma'nkam gu Siisera gu ma'nkam gu Tema.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nesiia gu ma'nkam gu atipa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sotai gu ma'nkam gu Soperet gu ma'nkam gu Perida.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jaala gu ma'nkam gu Darkoon gu ma'nkam gu Giddel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias gu ma'nkam gu attil gu ma'nkam gu Pokêret-assebaim gu ma'nkam gu Amoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Netineos tu' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Telmela gu Tel-arsa gu Kêrub gu Addoon tu' gu Immer cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tattat tu' gu ma'nkam tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Delaiia gu ma'nkam gu Tobiias gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu abaiias gu ma'nkam gu Kos gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Barsillai gu Galaadita jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Tirsata cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu Urim gu Tummim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't oo'm gook jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham tu duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jixchamaam; gio ba' buur jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhɨt chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Tirsata jix maa na ba' chumñigam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa na ba' chumñigam tu duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gook jix bhai'x jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix uam jodai gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix daa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Netineos bɨx gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' tɨbiap kɨɨv gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' jumaap bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ ɨrban vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu suudai' gui'p gu Esdras u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga vupui bhaan gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ bɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ba' jix kai maa'n gu tanoolh kɨɨv.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan vupui bhaan ɨrban vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu suudai' dɨr gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ pui'm; gio ba' maatɨt bɨx gu ja'tkam mi'p u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu Esdras gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan gu u'u gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' ju'ñdharan mi'p gu Matitiias gu Sema gu Aniias gu Uriias tu' gu ilkiias gu Maasiias gu novɨ tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ o'nsop gu Pedaiia gu Misael gu Malkîas gu asum gu asbedana gu Sakâriias gu Mesullam.
Na gu' jix kupi'ook gu Esdras u'uan gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p jix kupi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam juruuñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' jano' ba' gu Esdras gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Ameen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh; mi' dhɨr o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Jesuaa gu Bani gu Serebiias gu Jamiin gu Akkub gu Sabetai gu Odiias gu Maasiias gu Kelita gu Asariias gu Josabed gu anaan gu Pelaiia gu Lebitas ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ka't pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Neemiias gu Tirsata jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Esdras gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gui'p bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tɨiñ gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va cham namki'; na gu' gu tanoolh jix bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan; na gu' cham na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix bhaan cham.
Na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't jugi i'i tɨip gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' bhai' ñi'ook na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jum daa'ñ chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Esdras na ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu ñi'ook bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Jerusalem bham; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨx gu u'u na ba' a'ga na ja'p ua'nak.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu ja'tkam aichdhak tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ɨrban ki'ñgob gu suudai' ɨrban ki'ñgob gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix duu jix daa; na gu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham jix daa gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ka't bhai' ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Esdras u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm kuugalhdha'; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu tanoolh bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh maakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jum daa'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu oidha' bhaan.
Jano' ba' dua'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kua' tɨɨt uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt pai' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu Jesuaa gu Bani gu Kadmiel gu Sebaniias gu Bunni gu Serebiias gu Bani gu Kênani tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Lebitas gu Jesuaa gu Kadmiel gu Bani gu osabniias gu Serebiias gu Odaiias gu Sebaniias gu Petaiia; gio ba' gu Lebantaos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bɨɨx ka'm; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ' jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx jix bhai' aa' bhai' ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam jix buusñi gu Ur gu Kaldeos gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abraam.

Jano' ba' bakia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan na ba' jix maa gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Pereseo gu Jebuseo gu Gergeseo na ba' jix maa gu kai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taata'n tattat gu Ejipto tu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.
Jano' ba' chɨɨdak buimɨk kɨɨ'p gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gaki; gio ba' na ja'p gu jodai gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam toov gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu tai gu tukaa' na ba' gu bhóogɨt pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx dɨr gu tɨkɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juanda' jix bhaan gu novɨ gu Moisees tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr bhiogi' gu ñi'ook jix buusñi gu suudai' gu jodai; gio ba' tu ñi'ook ba'k gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu novɨ.
Gu' gu' taata'n tattat jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kɨɨ'p gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' uañi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook juantu'n; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' daak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch cham.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk jix duu na ba' tuur gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam cham oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' toov cham jix ai'chdhix gu tanoolh na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu tai gu tukaa' na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨɨdak gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu suudai' chɨɨdak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' matgɨm chooto'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jajannulhi'ñ cham tu' jix duñia' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Seoon gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon pai' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' tu ñi'ook tattat baakɨi bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Kananeos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na ba' aagak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu vaak jix bhuup bɨx jix bhai' oidha' u'va mui'x gu u'u jugi; gio ba' koi'mɨk jix gɨ' joi'gɨ'nda'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bhaan gu ñi'ook mu'aa jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan na ba' tu'; gio ba' tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñ tu ñi'ook tu' dɨr gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr bhaan mumua'da' boosolh dodhia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' ua'tulhdhidha' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ; gu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' dɨr gu tɨkɨr bhaan mumua'da' mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gu' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr jix maa jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mui'x bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu' cham jix kai; gio ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam cham tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch cham ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx tu jiim tu' jix duñia' gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Dios chiñia' gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Dios tattat bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' bɨx tu' tɨbiap bhaan no'ch; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu' no'ch gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' tattat cham jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu Sallai gu Kallai; gio ba' gu Amok gu Eber.
Jano' ba' gu ilkiias gu asabiias; gio ba' gu Jedaiias gu Natanael.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu tanoolh gu Eliasib gu Joiada gu Joanaan gu Jaddua jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu Persa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu u'uan bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu Joanaan gu mar gu Eliasib.

Jano' ba' ɨɨbhidham gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu asabiias gu Serebiias gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Kadmiel gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taxchaabgi'ñ jurtu'nka' ñi'ook kavɨk gu Dabii gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Mataniias gu Bakbukiias gu Obadiias gu Mesullam gu Talmoon gu Akkub nuuka'n jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook ba'k kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Joiakim gu mar gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadak gu tanoolh gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Neemiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Esdras gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas bɨx pai' na ba' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem na ba' duñia' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam vaak ja'tkam xikoolh gu Jerusalem na ja'p taañpu' gu Netopati.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Gilgal vaak ja'tkam gu Geba gu Asmabet; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taañpu' xikoolh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu ja'tkam kiki'ñgob vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ chiñia' gu Judaa bhaan vaak jodai gook jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' maa'n gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan vaak jodai bhaan ki'ñgob gu Muladar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Osaiias tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiñia' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias gu Esdras gu Mesullam.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu Semaiias gu Jeremiiyas.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Sakariias gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Semaiias gu mar gu Mataniias gu mar gu Mikâiias gu mar gu Sakûr gu mar gu Asap.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Semaiias gu Asarael gu Milalai gu Gilalai gu Maai gu Natanael gu Judaa gu anani bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Esdras vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Puente gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Dabii vaak jodai dɨr gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu suudai' tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' gook gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bhaan vaak jodai dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ornos bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' dɨr ki'ñgob gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu Peskado bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bhi'ñbak gu amat bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu Obejas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu Kaarkel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ o'rosiiris.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Eliakim gu Maaseiias gu Miniamin gu Mikâiias gu Elioenai gu Sakariias gu ananiias bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Maaseiias gu Semeiias gu Eleasar gu Ussi gu Joanaan gu Malkiias gu Elam gu Eser; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam alabaa'n jix bhai'x tu' gu Israiia ka't.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gio gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu Jerusalem ka't naak.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'nkar na jix maa boosgi na ba' vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; na gu' ka't jix gɨ' gu Judaa bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan na ja'p gio jurtu'nka' ñi'ook kavɨk gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Asap tu' jix bhai'x ka't chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu tanoolh gu Sorobabeel gu tanoolh gu Neemiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Lebitas baasɨ'n gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't gaagam ua'nak gu Ammonitas gu Moabitas cham baakɨi mɨɨjidha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' cham moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' va'k gu Balaam bhaan na ba'; gu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios mu'ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' va'k dhi' gu Eliasib jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Tobiias.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' ka't jix duñia' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu maa'nkar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Gu' gu' bɨx dhi' tu' cham ka't gu Jerusalem; na gu' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gook gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tɨbiap gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Eliasib gu Tobiias duñia' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Tobiias mai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas cham jix maa; gio ba' gu Lebitas duñia' jix duñia' maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'rosiiris tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios pai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam gu Selemiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Sadok gu Lebitas gu Pedaiias; gio ba' gu novɨ gu anaan gu mar gu Sakkur gu mar gu Mataniias; na gu' jix duñia' ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' cham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu' gu Judaa dhɨt jix duñia' gu Jawatan juanda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx suudai' u'va gio gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu tanoolh juanda'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh bɨxchu' jugi.
Jano' ba' gio mi'p gu Tirios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bɨxchu' juanda' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Judaa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' xoi'kam gu tanoolh juanda'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan no'ch bɨx dhi' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel juanda'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem va'k juanda' tu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob cham bɨɨx ka'm mi' dhɨr juanda'; gio ba' kiki'ñgob dhɨt na ba' gu tanoolh juanda' cham ba'k gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' gu Jerusalem gook mui'kim bɨxchu' bɨx na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak jodai tu' xoi'kam jix duñia' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr dɨr jano' ba' cham tɨɨtɨs juanda'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nukadham kiki'ñgob na ba' jix bhaan gu tanoolh juanda'; gio ba' gio dhi' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Judiios jix daa jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu Asdod gu Ammonitas gu Moabitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' nɨɨn gu ja'tkam; na cham ñiokda' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhɨt kuupa'n bham; gio ba' cham ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Bien mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p ka't dha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix duu jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨx dhi' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' jix duñia' bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios dhaagɨk gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Joiada gu mar gu Eliasib jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sanballat gu oronita; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu u'u gu ñi'ook miil na ba' gu ux na tu ibai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' xoi'kam.
